info.title: 3alraf Mobile API
info.description:
JSON API for the Flutter apps.

Tenant: use the store host ({tenant}.domain) or the central host plus the `X-Tenant` slug header. GET /api/v1/tenants (central) lists the stores.
Envelope: every response is {success, message, data, meta}; errors are {success:false, message, errors?, data:null, meta:{}} with 401/403/404/422/429.
Auth: Sanctum bearer tokens of two kinds. Customer tokens (ability `customer`, from /auth/login or /auth/register) and affiliate tokens (ability `affiliate`, from /affiliate/login) are not interchangeable and only work in the tenant that issued them.
Guests: send the `X-Cart-Token` returned by the first cart call; after login call POST /cart/merge (or send it with /auth/login) to merge it.
Checkout: place the order, then follow meta.next_action: redirect_to_payment (open meta.payment_url, then poll GET /payments/return/{token} until meta.paid), upload_proof (wallet transfer screenshot, POST /orders/{token}/proof), retry_payment (POST /orders/{token}/pay), none (COD). Orders always wait for the store admin to confirm.
Money values are decimal strings in the store currency. Cost, profit and commission fields are never exposed.
